thesis: GO is a strong relative-strength trend name in a defensive sector (grocery, Consumer Defensive) while the regime is risk-off and staples lead. The stock closed above SMA20, SMA50 and SMA200 near its 52-week high, and a pullback entry with a defined stop offers about 2.1 reward/risk. Short interest is very high, so any stabilisation after earnings can squeeze shorts. The honest caveat is that this is a weak, conditional setup. The ~7% pre-market gap down on unexplained earnings news, the missing news feed, a levered balance sheet and fundamentals scored -1 mean the bull case only works if price holds the SMA20 area and reclaims it, not by buying the open.
